decisions.reason: As the flagship platform built directly on the firm's core GIS and enterprise integration knowledge, its strong absorptive capacity and strategic focus make withdrawal very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture leverages the firm's existing web/mobile and user-focused design capabilities and offers learning from customer workflows, so it is likely retained.
The search extension is closely tied to the core map.apps platform and has shown continuous version updates, indicating the firm can assimilate feedback and improve it.
